title: Local positive exactness of the increasing-tuple module-sheaf complex
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme, $r\in\mathbb N$, $U:\operatorname{Fin}(r)\to X.\mathrm{Opens}$, $G$ an $\mathcal O_X$-module, and $i\in\operatorname{Fin}(r)$. Let $C$ be the restriction to $U_i$ of the integer extension by zero of the alternating Čech sheaf complex [def-pc-s3-alternating-cech-sheaf-construction]. For every integer $k>0$, the short complex $C^{k-1}\xrightarrow{d}C^k\xrightarrow{d}C^{k+1}$ is exact. No splittings or homotopies are chosen.

source.place: Tag 02FU (cohomology-lemma-covering-resolution), Cocycle primitive in the local insertion computation; increasing tuples as in Tag 01FM

proof.text: On each test open V of U_i, take its image W in X. The image is contained in U_i. The module-sheafification unit is invertible on every explicit term; its naturality commutes with each face differential. Pull a sheafified cocycle back along the middle unit, use injectivity of the outgoing unit to prove it is a presheaf cocycle, apply the sectionwise primitive lemma, and push the primitive forward along the incoming unit. This gives exactness at every module evaluation. Evaluation preserves presheaf homology and jointly detects zero objects, so the restricted underlying presheaf short complex is exact. The faithful module-sheaf forgetful functor reflects exactness.

For k>0 write k=p+1 for p in the natural numbers. Apply the restriction functor to the three canonical extendXIso maps in degrees k-1,k,k+1. The extend_d_eq identities make them an isomorphism from the integer restricted short complex to the natural-degree restricted short complex. Transport the exactness already proved along this isomorphism.

proof_origin.place: Tags 02FU and 01FM; M4 proof by sectionwise cocycle transport through sheafification units, faithful reflection, and extendXIso

lean.statement:
theorem alternatingCechSheaf_restrict_local_exact
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {r : ℕ} (U : Fin r → X.Opens) (G : X.Modules) (i : Fin r)
    (k : ℤ) :
    let F := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (U i).ι
    let C := (F.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
      ((alternatingCechSheafComplex U G).extend ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat)
    0 < k → (C.sc' (k - 1) k (k + 1)).Exact
